eras.before-1972: instants before 1972-01-01T00:00Z: both read as UT1 with the ΔT model
eras.1972-to-2027-10-02: instants from 1972-01-01T00:00Z to 2027-10-02T00:00Z: rc.15 reads them as UTC through the IERS leap seconds and UT1 − UTC, rc.14 as UT1 with the ΔT model
eras.after-2027-10-02: instants after 2027-10-02T00:00Z: both read as UT1 with the ΔT model

positions.description: computeBodies at every corpus instant: body order and every field of all twelve rows

singleBody.description: bodyLongitude and longitudeSpeed for all twelve bodies at every corpus instant

charts.description: computeChart at every corpus instant, six locations, whole sign and Placidus, time known; every field

unknownTime.description: computeChart at every corpus instant with no birth time, with and without a place

frozenNodePolar.description: the node/polar corpus: node instants through computeBodies, polar places through computeChart in both systems

swissBenchmarkCorpus.description: the Swiss benchmark's measure and holdout cases through computeChart, as dump-zodiacs.mjs casts them (Placidus, time known)

timeBasisEdges.description: the edges of rc.15's time basis at −1 s, −1 ms, 0, +1 ms and +1 s: computeBodies, computeChart (London, Placidus) and longitudeSpeed for all twelve bodies

progressions.description: progressedInstant and progressedBodies: the base commit's adapter on rc.14 against this branch's on rc.15; the era is the progressed instant's

progressionMapping.description: progressedInstant only, across the whole Date range, where no position is computed

invalidDates.description: invalid dates, which no site path passes: recorded, not required to agree
